scripts.build: npm run build -w @someonewithpc/paper && npm run build -w packages/react -w packages/vue -w packages/svelte -w packages/solid -w packages/astro
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && svelte-check --tsconfig ./packages/svelte/tsconfig.json --threshold warning && npm run check:astro
scripts.site:dev: npm run build && npm run dev -w site
scripts.site:build: npm run build && npm run build -w site
scripts.site:deploy: npm run site:build && npm run deploy -w site
scripts.release: npm run check:package && npm publish --workspaces --access public
